description: This file defines the 'Delegator' interface in Java for the Apache OFBiz framework. The interface specifies methods for entity management including create, read, update, delete (CRUD) operations, cache management, sequence handling, relationship retrieval, and other entity-related utilities within the framework.

classes.name: Delegator
classes.description: The 'Delegator' interface defines a contract for entity management operations in the OFBiz framework, including create, read, update, delete, caching, sequence, and relationship handling.
